scopeAndLimits: These 180 local boundary vectors are not published canonical corpus cases, a runtime implementation or a conformance receipt.
Fixture/key artifacts resolve exact shared values from the separately frozen step4-inputs.json. Literal replacements describe test seams rather than a production patch protocol.

The local two-theme package is derived neutral data, not a published release. Native storage validity, descriptor admission, glyph support and prepared geometry are supplied boundary facts where stated.
Nonempty archived DI is covered at its hash/preservation seam with descriptor validation assumed. The neutral descriptor slice is not a full native DI/DC descriptor set.
Report coordinate and ordering vectors use supplied diagnostic entries; generic fixture codes are not new adapter mappings. Only design-assigned codes are asserted for named adapters.
Refused verdicts without a code deliberately do not guess diagnostic spelling that the design leaves unspecified.
Signature timing, rollback, no-event and no-candidate records are expected contracts, not measured event-loop, canvas transaction or browser evidence.
Report JSON is stored with exact canonical UTF-8 strings and hashes. Terminal binary bytes, opaque runtime handles and session token allocation are not invented.
All new vectors remain pending independent review; no twin parity, final corpus approval or production activation is claimed.
Digest-only metric/payload mutations assert exact mathematical digest changes and refusal of the old render binding; they do not authorize changed resource bytes under unchanged package pins.
